summary: All 5 repair targets are valid question-shape issues. Apply repairs by removing embedded recommendations and rationale from q1 through q5.

items.title: 1. q1 includes answer/rationale text
items.rationale: The question is valid, but pending draft questions must contain only the question text. Recommendation and rationale belong in later user-facing choice presentation, not in draft.json qa[].question.
items.evidence: draft-review-questions.json repairTargets[0] reports q1 includes recommendation and rationale instead of only question text.

items.title: 2. q2 includes answer/rationale text
items.rationale: The fallback splitting question is still useful, but pending draft questions must not pre-answer the decision.
items.evidence: draft-review-questions.json repairTargets[1] reports q2 includes recommendation and rationale instead of only question text.

items.title: 3. q3 includes answer/rationale text
items.rationale: The excludePaths semantics question is still useful, but the recommendation and rationale should be removed from the draft question field.
items.evidence: draft-review-questions.json repairTargets[2] reports q3 includes recommendation and rationale instead of only question text.

items.title: 4. q4 includes answer/rationale text
items.rationale: The rawResponse and failure details question is still useful, but pending draft questions must not include the proposed answer.
items.evidence: draft-review-questions.json repairTargets[3] reports q4 includes recommendation and rationale instead of only question text.

items.title: 5. q5 includes answer/rationale text
items.rationale: The test strategy question is still useful, but pending draft questions must leave the answer and rationale empty.
items.evidence: draft-review-questions.json repairTargets[4] reports q5 includes recommendation and rationale instead of only question text.
